description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_VarParser_Flexible, which extends the HTMLPurifier_VarParser class. It implements a method parseImplementation() to parse variables based on specified types, handling various data transformations and potential errors. It is part of an HTML purification library focused on safe and flexible variable parsing.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_VarParser_Flexible
classes.description: A class that performs type-based safe variable parsing, extending the base parser class to handle more complex data input scenarios.

methods.name: parseImplementation
methods.description: Parses a variable according to the specified type, converting or validating it as needed, and handling errors if the data does not conform to expected formats.
